name: @effectified/codemirror-view
tagline: an editor whose document is the Model, its cursor kept

decisions.question: Which exported functions and classes does the facade offer?
decisions.why: EditorView is what the README's example constructs; the rest (ViewPlugin, Decoration, keymap, lineNumbers, ...) build Extensions an app passes to the Editor mount, imported from @codemirror/view itself. A frontend facade generates no wrappers from exports: kept for the record

decisions.question: Which method releases a EditorView, so acquiring one opens a scope? ("none" keeps it unscoped)
decisions.why: destroy() is CodeMirror's teardown (plugins, observers, its DOM); the Editor mount's release calls it

decisions.question: Which events of EditorView does the facade offer as Streams? ("none" for none)
decisions.why: the view has no event emitter: changes are read through an EditorView.updateListener extension, which the Editor mount installs and turns into messages

decisions.question: Which upstream failures become which tagged errors?
decisions.why: CodeMirror exports no error classes and sets no codes; a frontend facade generates no error mapping: kept for the record

decisions.question: Which handles are provided as services (Context.Service with a layer)?
decisions.why: a frontend facade generates no services; an EditorView lives with its element through the Editor mount, not for a program's lifetime: kept for the record

decisions.question: Which mounts does the frontend facade offer?
decisions.why: @codemirror/view owns EditorView (codemirror only re-exports it with basicSetup, which an app passes as an extension): one view on a <div>, created from its document and extensions, updated in place (a new document is one change, applied only when the view changed it and it is not the editor's own echo; new extensions reconfigure a compartment), its document and selection changes as messages, destroyed with the element

decisions.question: Which packages do the mounts import besides upstream?
decisions.why: the Editor mount builds its Compartments and transactions with it; at @codemirror/view's own range, since a second copy would reject the editor's extensions

decisions.question: Which revision of this upstream version is the facade?
decisions.why: engine 0.3.0: regenerated with the engine that makes the runtime facades cancel upstream; no change to this facade's API
